EVE Quartermaster: early beta / public preview

EVE is Excel in a flight suit, and I apparently decided it needed a quartermaster.

EVE Quartermaster is a web-based EVE Online operations tool focused on asset management, industry, character tracking, corporation support, hauling intel, and long-term analytics.

It started as a small personal project and escalated quickly. The goal is not to replace tools like DOTLAN, Janice, zKillboard, or EVEMon. EQM is meant to sit beside them and bring the information I personally keep reaching for into one place.

eqm-logo1774×887 150 KB

Current features include:

  • EVE SSO character linking and ESI sync

  • Character skills, skill queues, ownership, scope checks, and privacy controls

  • Character and corporation asset sync

  • Corporation blueprint sync

  • Corporation wallet division sync

  • Asset ledger with filters, search, CSV export, and Janice-friendly copy output

  • Blueprint and recipe views using imported SDE data

  • Corporation pages with sync status, CEO/member metadata where available, wallet divisions, and eligible sync characters

  • Contact and standing propagation tools

  • Notifications, private messages, permissions, and admin audit log

  • Historical analytics foundation with snapshots, deltas, exports, and widgets

  • Route planning, gatecheck summaries, operational starmap rendering, and security-status coloring

  • Hauling intel widgets for industrial kill heat, PvP system intel, smartbomb indicators, and local threat analysis

  • Jump Freighter plotter with JDC/JFC fuel math, station/cyno guidance, route context, and recent industrial kill visibility

Optional sideloadable Android WebView APK for Android devices

Requirements and deployment notes

EQM requires Docker or Docker Desktop.

It has been tested using Docker Desktop on Windows 11 Pro, both through localhost and through a reverse proxy for public access.

Current published host ports:

  • 5173 - frontend web app / Vite

  • 8000 - backend API

  • 5432 - PostgreSQL

  • 6379 - Redis

Internally:

  • The frontend proxies /api to the backend at backend:8000

  • The backend talks to PostgreSQL at postgres:5432

  • The backend and worker talk to Redis at redis:6379

For public reverse proxy exposure, you usually only need to expose/proxy port 5173, unless you deliberately want direct API access.

ESI scopes

EQM requests a broad set of ESI scopes because it is designed to support character, corporation, industry, asset, wallet, structure, contact, market, contract, fittings, killmail, and analytics workflows.

Requested scopes currently include skills, skill queue, character and corporation wallets, structure search/access, clones and implants, contacts, standings, killmails, assets, PI, UI waypoint/window support, fittings, structure markets, corporation structures, loyalty, medals, research agents, industry jobs, market orders, blueprints, corporation roles, contracts, corporation standings, mining ledgers, customs offices, titles, alliance contacts, faction warfare stats, and structure access.

This is still early beta. There are rough edges, performance work still to do, and the API/data model are moving quickly. That said, it has reached the point where I think it may be useful to other pilots, especially industrialists, haulers, quartermasters, CEOs, and anyone who likes turning New Eden’s chaos into readable tables.

At this stage I’m primarily looking for pilots willing to install it, put it through its paces, and tell me what works, what doesn’t, and what they’d like to see added. If you manage an industrial corporation, logistics operation, or alliance infrastructure, your feedback would be especially valuable.

EQM v0.1.4-beta - Context At A Glance Update

Releases

Changelog

All notable changes to EVE Quartermaster are tracked here.

This project is moving quickly during beta. Version sections are written as user-facing release notes first, with implementation detail included where it helps operators understand deployment or testing impact.

[0.1.4-beta] - 2026-07-06

Changed

  • Bumped the visible app, README, Android wrapper, backend API, and ESI client user-agent versions for the latest beta polish pass.

[0.1.3-beta] - 2026-07-05

Added

  • Added cross-section context links: fittings now show owned hull/modules/cargo/drones and can price missing or full fits; market appraisal lines show owned quantities with asset/fitting jumps; assets can jump to pricing or fittings; recipes and blueprints show owned outputs/material coverage with market handoffs.
  • Added the Market Appraisal module for Janice-style pasted item lists with flexible quantity parsing, multi-hub buy/sell/split comparisons, Dudreda support, and unmatched-item warnings.
  • Added market usability signals: best instant-sale highlighting, cheapest acquisition highlighting, best split estimate highlighting, order-depth health badges, and top buy-here/sell-there margin hints.
  • Added Contracts support for syncing current character contracts and eligible corporation contracts, with status filtering and sortable contract headers.
  • Added fitting clipboard import so EFT-style fits can be pasted into EQM as editable draft fittings.
  • Added fitting editor improvements: drag/drop part picker, module removal, charge/script assignment for valid fitted modules, cleaner cargo/drone/fighter rows, cargo hold display, and EVE-style copy/export behavior.
  • Added deeper fitting simulation surfaces for readiness, resources, offense, tank, capacitor, movement, module state cycling, hot/overheated module states, charge-aware weapon estimates, and fitting-derived skill plan copy text.
  • Added Capital Jump Plotter refinements: capital ship selection, NPC-station-only routing text, green-station filtering, industrial/all-kill selection, station/cyno guidance display, route avoid-list controls, and per-waypoint observed activity intel from cached hourly ESI jump observations.

Changed

  • Renamed the character standing sync area to Character Contacts Sync to match the actual writable ESI mechanic.
  • Kept market appraisal freight-cost estimates out of the first implementation because player hauling, Red Frog Freight, PushX, and private logistics pricing need a more explicit model.
  • Improved public-facing README documentation and screenshot ordering for tester onboarding.

Fixed

  • Market appraisal opportunity cards now only show profitable station-to-station trades; no-profit appraisals show a neutral no-current-profit badge instead of a negative trade suggestion.
  • Corporation sync flows now continue past corporations where the linked character lacks the required corporation roles instead of stopping the whole batch.
  • Improved station display plumbing for jump planning so NPC station names can be shown separately from station type/cyno-risk guidance when SDE data is available.

[0.1.2-beta] - 2026-07-05

Baseline

  • First tracked beta baseline for the public-testing README badge and in-app version badge.
  • Included account login, EVE SSO linking, asset and corporation syncs, blueprint/SDE import, analytics foundations, navigation tooling, local threat scanning, permissions, audit visibility, messaging, Android wrapper support, and initial fitting tools.# Changelog

[0.1.7-beta] - 2026-07-13

Added

  • Added a Characters-page Sync all eligible action that queues assets, skills, fittings, and contracts for every permitted non-opted-out character with matching ESI scopes and shows queue-badge progress.
  • Added corporation hiding and tightened character/corporation lists so metadata-only CEOs and affiliation-only corporations do not appear as managed EQM entries.

[0.1.6-beta] - 2026-07-10

Added

  • Started frontend segmentation by moving the app version, killmail data shapes, and wardec badge into purpose-built modules.

  • Split the Contracts page and contract data shapes out of the large frontend entry module.
  • Split the Corporations page and corporation sync data shapes out of the large frontend entry module.
  • Extracted the shared frontend API client and inventory classification/types helpers out of the large frontend entry module.
  • Added SDE-backed category and subtype filters for Assets and Blueprint Library views, including ship hull classes, ammunition/charge groups, rig groups, and capital-construction blueprint chain filtering.
  • Added a Missing BPOs pane at the bottom of the Blueprint Library, grouped by product category from the SDE manufacturing catalog.
  • Added fitting ammo/script groups so multiple launchers, turrets, or scripted modules can share charge assignment from one group control.
  • Added reusable pilot security-status badges for character cards, local threat pilots, route killmail rows, and jump-planner killmail rows.
  • Added a Skills-page sync-all action that queues backend skill refreshes for every eligible character, skips opted-out characters, and shows progress with the queue badge.
  • Added prompted prerequisite bootstrapping to the Windows and Linux installer scripts for Git, WSL2, Docker Desktop, Docker Engine, and Docker Compose support.

Fixed

  • Made character hover cards persist until closed with the new X button or Escape so zKill links and card actions remain reachable.
  • Widened the character picker pane so persistent character hover cards show their close button without horizontal scrolling.
  • Raised Skills-page character hover cards above neighboring skill profile rows so persistent character summaries stay readable while open.
  • Restored character dossier blueprint-product fallback logic so character pages no longer 500 when loading visible characters.
  • Converted undecryptable ESI refresh tokens into a clear reauthorization-needed sync error instead of a 500 during asset sync.
  • Backfilled blueprint product classification from SDE industry activities so blueprint category/subtype filters populate correctly, including Drones/Fighters.
  • Kept final capital, freighter, and jump freighter hull BPOs out of the Capital construction blueprint filter while retaining supporting chain inputs/components.

  • Applied strategic cruiser subsystem slot/resource dogma before fitting simulation readiness checks so T3C CPU, powergrid, slot capacities, probe launcher CPU, covert cloak CPU, and medium weapon required-skill fitting reductions are not evaluated from bare hull/module values only.
  • Stored ESI character security status during public character imports and SSO sync so pilot identity surfaces can display current security information when available.

Changed

  • Renamed Capital Jump Plotter to Jump Capable Ship Plotter and added Black Ops battleships to the jump-capable ship list.
  • Reorganized the sidebar navigation into overview/navigation, character functions, inventory and industry tools, and account/admin groups.
  • Tuned the frontend typography hierarchy to reduce over-bold repeated labels, table values, filter chips, badges, and utility buttons so dense operational pages are easier to scan.
  • Replaced the Overview Blueprint Library panel with a lightweight blueprint preview so dashboard loads do not initialize the full blueprint tooling or Missing BPO pane.
  • Bumped the visible app and package version to 0.1.6-beta.

[0.1.5-beta] - 2026-07-08

  • Added a Prefer Safer Route option to Route Checker so gate routes can favor highsec travel even when the route becomes longer.
  • Added Route Checker avoid-list controls matching the Capital Jump Plotter flow, including per-system avoid buttons and a clearable avoid list.

EQM v0.1.9-beta “Build A Battleship” Version

EVE is Excel in a flight suit, but perhaps we can reduce the number of spreadsheets required.

EVE Quartermaster v0.1.9-beta is now available on GitHub.

This release introduces two major modules: a Manufacturing ledger for tracking the real economics of production, and a Jump Clones workspace for managing implants and experimenting with fitting configurations.

Manufacturing

The new Manufacturing module records production from initial inputs through final disposition.

  • Track manufacturing, ME/TE research, copying, invention, and reactions.
  • Enter multiple BPO/BPC, mineral, component, PI, datacore, decryptor, ship, and miscellaneous inputs.
  • Compare Current Price against Price Paid, including materials already on hand.
  • Look up input and final-product prices across the major trade hubs.
  • Highlight the best available buy and sell opportunities.
  • Track installation fees, start times, expected completion, and job status.
  • Mark output as pending, kept, or sold and record the actual sale price.
  • Measure market-value savings, production cost, revenue, and realized profit.
  • Feed completed production into new Manufacturing analytics widgets.

It is designed to answer the question that inevitably follows “Can we build it?”:

“Did we actually save or make any ISK by building it?”

Jump Clones And Implants

The new Jump Clones module provides a central view of character clones and implant sets.

  • Synchronize jump clones and implants through ESI.
  • Resolve known station and location names from the SDE.
  • Display implant icons, slots, attributes, and dogma information.
  • Inspect implant details from interactive hover cards.
  • Create custom experimental implant sets without altering an in-game clone.
  • Associate experimental sets with characters for fitting comparisons.
  • Select a character and implant set from the Fittings module.

Other Recent Improvements

The recent beta cycle also added:

  • A queued Sync All workflow for eligible characters that respects privacy opt-outs.
  • Server-backed Assets pagination with a substantially smaller browser-memory footprint.
  • Blueprint filtering by hull, ammunition, rig, drone/fighter, reaction, RAM, and capital-component categories.
  • A categorized Missing BPO catalog.
  • A persistent Threat Analyzer action available throughout EQM.
  • Security-status indicators on character and threat surfaces.
  • Black Ops support in the Jump Capable Ship Plotter.
  • Improved installers and automated SDE download scripts.
  • A large frontend refactor that reduced the original main.tsx monolith into maintainable feature modules.

Fittings Preview Notice

The Fittings simulator remains an experimental feature preview. Dogma, skills, implants, cargo, module effects, and derived values are still being rebuilt and may be incomplete or inaccurate.

Please verify important fits in-game or with an established fitting tool.

Download And Documentation

  • Download EQM v0.1.9-beta
  • Project repository and setup guide
  • Report a bug or request a feature

EQM is self-hosted, AGPL-3.0-or-later licensed, and built with React, FastAPI, PostgreSQL, Redis, Docker Compose, EVE ESI, and the YAML Static Data Export.

Testing, feedback, bug reports, and contributions are welcome.

EQM v0.1.10-beta: “Cook It, Then Log the Mats”

EVE Quartermaster v0.1.10-beta is now available, introducing two new industry-focused modules alongside improvements to Analytics, Manufacturing, contract synchronization, and the interface.

Release: EQM v0.1.10-beta
Repository: EVE Quartermaster on GitHub

Mining Ledger

The new persistent, per-character Mining Ledger can:

  • Synchronize personal mining history through ESI.
  • Import detailed CSV or TSV ledger exports containing residue and valuation data.
  • Track recovered volume, gross extraction, residue loss, estimated value, and measured efficiency.
  • Compare ore composition, mining output over time, system extraction, and individual miner performance.
  • Create named mining operations using a solar system, time window, selected miners, and fleet boosters.
  • Record optional ship and mining-crystal information for operation participants.
  • Preserve historical records after they disappear from ESI’s rolling history window.
  • Safely clear an individual character’s ledger when an import is assigned incorrectly.

ESI supplies the ore type, quantity, date, and solar system for each mining record. Residue and exported valuation data are available only through detailed ledger imports.

Research Projects

Research Projects provides a dedicated view for:

  • Material Efficiency and Time Efficiency research.
  • Blueprint copying and invention.
  • Character-owned and corporation-owned industry jobs.
  • Installer attribution for corporation jobs.
  • Sortable project columns and active research queues.
  • Retained project history.
  • Researcher and activity analytics.
  • Corporation-role validation before corporate research synchronization begins.

eqm-mining-ledger994×700 77.2 KB

eqm-mining-analytics994×700 59.4 KB

Manufacturing and Analytics

  • Manufacturing drafts can now be started directly from the ledger, automatically recording their start time and beginning the countdown.
  • Manufacturing cards now identify the EQM user who submitted each job.
  • Corporations can be excluded from Analytics independently.
  • Hidden corporations are automatically excluded from summaries, trends, exports, duplicate-blueprint results, and subsequent snapshots.
  • NPC corporations and affiliation-only corporations can also be excluded without being added as managed corporations.

Fixes and Refinements

  • Fixed contract synchronization failures caused by player-owned structure IDs exceeding the size of the previous station field.
  • Prevented shared contracts from being reassigned when another character or corporation synchronizes the same contract.
  • Sync All now preserves and displays every individual task failure.
  • Fixed an issue that prevented Mining Sync data from persisting correctly.
  • Fixed transparent or incorrectly layered Jump Clone implant dogma cards.
  • Characters without active ESI connections no longer appear in Mining Ledger character lists.
  • Research Projects now uses a sortable table and validates corporation roles before synchronization.

Fittings Notice

The Fittings module remains an active work in progress and is now clearly marked as such in the navigation menu.

Dogma calculations, skills, implants, cargo, and derived fitting values should still be treated as preview functionality and independently verified before relying on them.

Feedback, testing reports, and suggestions are welcome.

EVE Quartermaster Update v0.1.11-beta: Host Tools, Backups & Multibuy Export

This update introduces a new Host account role for installation owners, complete database-management tools, and a faster way to move shopping lists into EVE Online.

Release: EQM v0.1.11-beta
Repository: EVE Quartermaster on Github

New Features

  • Export the EQM database as a portable .eqmbackup file
  • Restore a compatible database backup
  • View database size, table count, and schema version
  • Clear application data when a genuinely fresh start is required
  • Existing primary administrators are automatically promoted to Host
  • Database controls are visible and accessible only to Host accounts
  • Copy shopping lists directly to the clipboard in EVE Online Multibuy format
  • Export either missing items only or the complete shopping list, regardless of current asset coverage

Shopping-list exports use EVE’s simple item-and-quantity format:

Heavy Beam Laser II 5
Valkyrie II 5
Warrior II 10

Paste the result directly into EVE’s Multibuy window without removing prices, categories, or other formatting first.

Safety Measures

Database restoration verifies the backup format and schema version before proceeding and performs restoration transactionally. Database clearing requires both the Host password and an exact confirmation phrase.

The danger zone clearly identifies that clearing the database is irreversible. It removes synced ESI data, assets, industry history, analytics, notes, and other application records while retaining the current Host account and database structure.

Backups may contain private application data, encrypted ESI tokens, and account password hashes. Treat exported backup files as sensitive.

Additional Fixes

  • Added PostgreSQL client compatibility handling for reliable restores
  • Prevented internal migration metadata from conflicting during restoration
  • Protected the final Host account from deletion or demotion
  • Updated permissions throughout EQM to recognize the new Host role
  • Improved shopping-list exports for both procurement and full-fit purchasing

The complete backup, clear, and restore process was tested through an isolated database rehearsal before release.

EVE Quartermaster v0.1.14-beta You Give Me ISK, I Give You That

EVE Quartermaster v0.1.14-beta is now available!

This update introduces the Corporate Exchange, improves ESI location resolution, and expands Planetary Industry and inventory analytics. Much of this release—including the Corporate Exchange—was shaped directly by user feedback.

Corporate Exchange

Members can now list ships, materials, blueprints, packages, and services through an alliance or corporation marketplace.

Highlights include:

  • Fixed-price and auction listings
  • Public, account-free share links
  • Partial quantities or complete-lot sales
  • Five-hub market appraisals covering Jita, Amarr, Dodixie, Rens, and Hek
  • Public and authenticated bids
  • Seller bid review, reservations, transaction records, and notifications
  • Owner editing, restocking, pricing, visibility, expiration, and handoff controls
  • Protection for stock and package contents once committed to a reservation or bid
  • EVE Mail recipient-copy support for contacting sellers in-game

ESI Location Resolution

Corporation inventory now resolves more of the raw hierarchy previously shown as office, container, or CorpSAG identifiers.

The updated resolver:

  • Follows nested corporation asset parent chains
  • Resolves offices inside accessible third-party Upwell structures
  • Uses authenticated structure lookups when /universe/names/ is insufficient
  • Displays configured corporation hangar division names
  • Retains an explicit raw-ID fallback when ESI correctly refuses to disclose a private structure

Planetary Industry

This release also adds a new Planetary Industry workspace with:

  • ESI colony and layout synchronization
  • SDE-backed schematic names and production recipes
  • Extractor and factory production projections
  • Routing and storage warnings
  • Character, system, and planet filters
  • Historical PI production analytics and pilot rankings

Additional Improvements

  • Blueprint analytics now account for active, paused, and ready-for-delivery research and copying jobs without duplicating inventory.
  • Jump Clone tools can export appraisal-ready implant shopping lists for one clone, an entire character, or a custom implant set.
  • Corporate Exchange screenshots and updated documentation have been added to the project README.
  • Focused regression coverage was added for Corporate Exchange workflows, corporation metadata, Planetary Industry, ESI authorization scopes, and blueprint shadow inventory.

EVE Quartermaster remains beta software. Back up your database before upgrading and review the release notes for deployment details.

EQM v0.1.16-beta: Plan It, Jump It, Let the Dice Roll Update!

This release brings three substantial new toolsets to EVE Quartermaster: corporation event planning, smarter capital navigation, and a manual-first HyperNet tracking workspace. It also includes the Corporate Exchange EVE Mail integration introduced in v0.1.15-beta, Analytics improvements, and several important fixes.

Download EQM v0.1.16-beta

Plan It — Calendar & Events

The new Calendar & Events workspace helps corporations organize operations from initial planning through final attendance reporting.

  • Schedule events with roles, ship requirements, fleet composition, and operational details.

  • Register multiple linked characters from a single EQM account.

  • Set each character independently as Going or Maybe.

  • Record actual attendance separately from RSVP data.

  • Add walk-ins and public participants who did not register through EQM.

  • Review participation analytics, registration totals, attendance, and event activity over time.

Jump It — Smarter Capital Navigation

The Jump Capable Ship Plotter has received a major navigation upgrade.

  • Enter an ordered list of established cyno systems that must be included in the route.

  • EQM automatically fills valid intermediate jumps between the origin, required cynos, and destination.

  • View alternate jump systems for each leg directly on the operational map.

  • Alternates clearly identify systems with NO STATION or ONLY RED STATIONS.

  • Recalculate the remaining route through a selected alternate with one click.

  • Existing ship, skill, fuel, station-safety, avoidance, and intel settings are retained when replanning.

  • If an established cyno can no longer be included in the revised route, EQM names it in a visible warning placard.

This makes the plotter useful both for constructing a route and for evaluating an existing cyno chain when local activity or a system’s reputation makes the original plan undesirable.

Let the Dice Roll — HyperNet Tracker

The new HyperNet Tracker provides a dedicated workspace for planning and monitoring HyperNet offers.

Because HyperNet offer data is not exposed through ESI, the tracker is intentionally manual-first.

  • Calculate price per node, the 5% HyperNet fee, HyperCore expenses, total payout, net proceeds, projected profit, break-even pricing, and target margins.

  • Record offer progress snapshots and participant observations.

  • Distinguish seller-seeded nodes from organic sales to better understand exposure and risk.

  • Reconcile completed or expired offers against their planned results.

  • Retain offer history for later review.

Whether you are pricing a new offer or reviewing how one actually performed, the tracker keeps the numbers and observations in one place.

Corporate Exchange EVE Mail Integration

Introduced in v0.1.15-beta, public Corporate Exchange listings can now open a polished, pre-addressed purchase-request draft directly in the buyer’s running EVE client.

The buyer completes a one-time EVE SSO authorization, reviews the generated message, and chooses whether to send it. This replaces the previous clipboard-only seller contact action.

Analytics and Performance

  • Corporation wallet and blueprint trends now use proper daily closing values instead of repeating raw-refresh patterns.

  • Corporations are displayed with distinct colors, trend lines, and latest-value legends.

  • Automatic snapshots are scope-aware and coalesce identical source data for one hour, reducing unnecessary database growth.

  • Analytics summary and history queries have been streamlined.

  • Additional history indexes improve larger installations.

  • A persistent loading placard warns users that Analytics may take time and should not be interrupted by refreshing.

  • Hosts can inspect Analytics storage usage and run confirmation-gated compaction while preserving manual snapshots and the latest complete automatic daily snapshot.

Additional Fixes

  • Characters disappear from the active Characters list immediately after their final token is revoked.

  • Historical records associated with unlinked characters remain available.

  • Version information throughout EQM has been updated to v0.1.16-beta.

Thanks to everyone providing feedback and testing beta builds. Several of these additions—especially the Corporate Exchange workflow—were developed directly from user feedback.

Get EQM v0.1.16-beta

EQM v0.1.17-beta: More Data, More Sauce!

EVE Quartermaster’s latest beta adds deeper financial history, smarter blueprint intelligence, live PI projections, and a substantial mobile/foldable interface pass.

Financial Analytics

EQM can now build long-term character wallet history from each eligible sync:

  • Wallet balance trends and net change
  • Percentage and average daily growth
  • Largest gains and losses
  • Income and spending velocity
  • Item-enriched market transactions
  • A financial timeline explaining major wallet movements

Privacy remains pilot-controlled:

  • Personal wallet history is private to the owning account.
  • Corporation analytics participation requires explicit pilot opt-in.
  • Staff cannot opt pilots in or override their selection.
  • A hard opt-out deletes stored wallet history and prevents future collection.
  • Corporation wealth combines all synced corporate wallet divisions with only explicitly opted-in pilot wallets.
  • Raw corporation totals remain hidden unless a director enables them for authorized officers.
  • No public “richest pilot” leaderboard.

Blueprint Intelligence

Hover over a blueprint name on desktop to see a clean operational summary:

  • ME and TE
  • BPO/BPC status and remaining runs
  • Owner and location
  • Whether the blueprint is currently in use
  • Active job, installer, facility, runs, status, and completion time

These cards appear throughout the Blueprint Library, Overview, Recent Assets, character dossiers, item context, recipes, missing-BPO results, research queues, active projects, and blueprint analytics.

Smarter Planetary Industry

PI projections now advance locally from the last ESI checkpoint, simulating:

  • Extractor cycles
  • Routed commodities
  • Factory production
  • Storage capacity
  • Starved factories
  • Blocked outputs

EQM clearly distinguishes projected inventories from the last values actually observed through ESI and warns when the underlying checkpoint is stale.

Character Skills and Responsive UI

  • Detailed skill dogma cards now show descriptions, rank, attributes, prerequisites, per-level bonuses, effective trained bonuses, affected categories, and useful EVE IDs.
  • Dogma results are cached locally for faster repeat access.
  • Character Skills cards, controls, navigation, statistics, and action groups now adapt more cleanly across phones, foldables, and tablets.
  • Primary actions remain visible while secondary report tools move into a compact menu where space is limited.

Sync and Sign-In Improvements

  • Character sync polling can now continue for up to 30 minutes before timing out.
  • Wallet collection participates in Sync All when the required ESI scope is available.
  • Financial privacy and general character sync opt-outs are enforced as hard boundaries.
  • The new optional Remember me setting provides a secure 30-day cookie-based login.

This remains beta software, so backups before updating are always a fine idea—and feedback continues to directly shape what EQM becomes.

EQM v0.1.18-beta — Learn It, Use It, Lose It and Get It Back!

EVE Quartermaster v0.1.18-beta substantially expands EQM’s fleet-planning, reimbursement, fitting, industry, export, synchronization, and analytics capabilities.

Download EQM v0.1.18-beta

New: Doctrine Management

Build complete operational doctrines rather than linking a single fit.

  • Create named, prioritized doctrines.
  • Attach multiple fittings to each doctrine.
  • Designate primary, core, and support fits.
  • Create fittings inline from EFT.
  • Link multiple skill plans, including fit-specific plans.
  • Combine plans into reviewed master skill plans.
  • Run multi-hub market appraisals for individual fits or the entire doctrine.
  • Archive doctrines without breaking historical events or SRP records.
  • Deep-link directly from a doctrine to its associated fitting or skill plan.

EQM Doctrine Management1630×1428 212 KB

New: Skill Plans

Skill Plans are now integrated into Character Skills and Doctrine Management.

  • Build and edit plans manually.
  • Generate plans from doctrines and fittings using imported SDE Dogma.
  • Include hulls, modules, rigs, drones, fighters, charges, scripts, and recursive prerequisites.
  • Compare plans against linked characters.
  • See complete, partially trained, and missing requirements.
  • Merge multiple plans while retaining the highest requested level of each skill.
  • Export plans in an EVE-compatible clipboard format.
  • Download plans as UTF-8 text files.
  • Receive a warning when a plan exceeds EVE’s 150-level personal-plan limit.

New: Ship Replacement Program

EQM now includes a durable, operation-oriented SRP system.

Staff can create SRP instances for specific operations and distribute generated submission links. Pilots submit losses directly against the correct operation, doctrine, fitting, and character.

The workflow supports:

  • Draft, Submitted, Under Review, Approved, Rejected, and Paid states.
  • Open or closed operation intake.
  • Doctrine and fitting snapshots that remain accurate after later edits.
  • Configurable loss reasons and reimbursement values.
  • Duplicate, invalid, test, and cancelled record handling.
  • Optional encrypted killmail hashes.
  • Fixed-precision ISK values.
  • Append-only review and workflow history.
  • Permission-enforced officer review.
  • Stable character, corporation, alliance, location, and ship snapshots.

EQM SRP Operations1630×1428 244 KB

New: SRP Analytics

The new SRP Analytics workspace provides:

  • Loss and reimbursement trends.
  • Custom UTC/EVE-time reporting ranges.
  • Doctrine, fitting, ship, class, pilot, operation, organization, location, and status breakdowns.
  • Requested, approved, and paid reimbursement comparisons.
  • Reimbursement-gap reporting.
  • Data-quality indicators and aggregate drilldowns.
  • Detailed and aggregate CSV exports.
  • Proper treatment of unknown valuations—they remain unknown rather than silently becoming zero.

Members see only their permitted records, while officers receive the wider SRP view granted by their role.

EQM SRP Analytics1630×1428 235 KB

Major Fitting Improvements

The fitting simulator’s common cold-fit calculation path has been rebuilt around imported SDE Dogma and character skills.

Improved calculations include:

  • Turret, launcher, and drone damage.
  • Hull and trained-skill bonuses.
  • Resistances and compensation skills.
  • Extenders, plates, repairers, and applicable rigs.
  • Capacitor capacity, recharge, and module draw.
  • Propulsion, agility, signature radius, and targeting.
  • Loaded ammunition, charges, and scripts.
  • Command bursts and burst charges.
  • Drone activation state.
  • T2 hull-skill routing.
  • Module fitting-resource reductions.

Additional fitting fixes include:

  • T2 ammunition such as Scorch and Conflagration now appears for compatible weapons.
  • Drone Damage Amplifiers, Drone Link Augmentors, and Omnidirectional Tracking Links import into their proper fitting slots.
  • Offline or inactive modules and drones no longer contribute active effects.
  • Command Bursts remain in high slots during import and draft repair.
  • Shield booster repair is no longer mistaken for permanent shield capacity.
  • Afterburner capacitor use now includes the applicable trained skills.

Reference fittings have been checked against Pyfa 2.68.0, with selected results also cross-checked against the EVE fitting simulator.

Send to EVE

Saved and draft fittings can now be sent directly to a selected linked EVE character.

EQM requests esi-fittings.write_fittings.v1 only when needed and keeps the resulting write authorization private to the owning account—even EQM staff cannot use another pilot’s fitting token.

Assets and Blueprint Exports

Assets and Blueprint Library data can now be exported as CSV or JSON.

  • Export the current filter or every accessible record.
  • Stable EVE type, item, owner, container, and location IDs.
  • Versioned export schemas and UTC generation timestamps.
  • Exact 64-bit IDs preserved safely in JSON.
  • BPO/BPC research and industry-job context.
  • Category, group, volume, pricing, and synchronization fields.
  • Optional owner and location suppression.
  • User-defined location aliases.
  • Keyed hashing for sensitive IDs.
  • The same authorization rules as the normal EQM interface.

Blueprint export location resolution now follows container and corporation-inventory ancestry to the containing station or Upwell structure. Exports distinguish resolved, parent-resolved, anonymized, inaccessible, and unresolved locations and include a data-quality summary.

Blueprints temporarily installed in ME, TE, or copying jobs also remain visible in the Blueprint Library and are no longer incorrectly reported as missing.

Research and Manufacturing

Manufacturing jobs now appear alongside ME, TE, copying, and invention in Research Projects.

This includes:

  • Character and corporation jobs.
  • Active and historical views.
  • Activity filters.
  • Manufacturing summary counts.
  • Installer, facility, timing, and status details.
  • Analytics attribution.

Sync and Freshness Center

Bulk synchronization is now much easier to follow.

  • Character Data, Character Skills, Mining, Research, and Planetary Industry jobs persist when you leave their module.
  • Returning to the module resumes the same progress indicator.
  • Active bulk coordinators appear in the ESI Sync & Freshness Center.
  • The center reports dataset age, active and failed jobs, never-synced data, missing scopes, and privacy-disabled collection.
  • Privacy opt-outs are identified as intentional states rather than failures.
  • Bulk-job visibility remains scoped to the account that started the job.

Analytics Improvements

Analytics received substantial storage, accuracy, and presentation improvements.

  • New Full History and Changes + Daily Checkpoints retention modes.
  • Lower-storage mode is the default for new installations.
  • Existing installations remain on Full History until changed by a host.
  • Metric-level aggregation and privacy metadata are now enforced.
  • Wallet balance metrics provide on-demand daily and weekly deltas, percentage growth, and 30-day rolling averages.
  • Historical ranges include an opening baseline from before the selected window.
  • New Change Composition reporting separates organic change from newly tracked coverage.
  • Newly linked characters no longer appear to have suddenly trained enormous amounts of SP.
  • Gain rankings require a real comparison baseline.
  • Charts now use dynamic ranges, readable tick intervals, peak headroom, adaptive date labels, and hover crosshairs.
  • Coverage notices report the history EQM actually possesses rather than implying a full selected period.

Additional Fixes

  • Fixed Doctrine and Skill Plan text fields losing focus after every keystroke.
  • Fixed repeated character-wallet journal entries failing an entire sync.
  • Fixed stale nested SDE files taking precedence over newer imported data.
  • Fixed duplicate placeholder groups during large SDE imports.
  • Fixed Character Data Sync appearing inactive while its bulk coordinator was running.
  • Character sheets now show both base NPC standing and skill-modified effective standing.
  • Duplicate-blueprint analytics now reads the current permission-scoped inventory.

Under the Hood

  • Added four database migrations for doctrines, multi-fit doctrines, linked skill plans, and durable SRP analytics.
  • Added an isolated Python 3.12 test image and Compose test profile.
  • Added versioned fitting-reference fixtures and provenance requirements.
  • Added a third-party research and licensing ledger.
  • Documented feature-direction research informed by the MIT-licensed EVE Buddy project while retaining an independent EQM implementation.
  • Current backend release suite: 242 tests passed, plus 3 subtests.
  • Frontend TypeScript and production Vite build verified.

This remains beta software, particularly around the long tail of EVE’s Dogma effect graph. Back up your installation before upgrading and please report any fitting, export, permission, or migration oddities you encounter.

EQM v0.1.20-beta: Bounties, Blasters & Better Intel!

EVE Quartermaster v0.1.20-beta introduces two major intelligence modules, expands historical analytics, makes large EQM datasets easier to search, and turns character synchronization into a genuine one-stop operation.

Download EQM v0.1.20-beta

EQM Killboard

The new EQM Killboard builds locally retained combat history using zKillboard for discovery and EVE ESI for authoritative killmail records.

  • Recent kills and losses
  • Character, corporation, and combined-account summaries
  • ISK destroyed, ISK lost, and efficiency
  • Solo versus fleet participation
  • Final blows and damage contribution
  • Most-used, destroyed, and lost hulls
  • Activity by system, region, and security class
  • Recurring opponents and frequently associated pilots
  • Kill/loss streaks and inactivity tracking
  • Direct links to the corresponding zKillboard pages
  • Incremental and resumable synchronization
  • Locally retained canonical ESI records and source payloads

Public combatants are resolved through ESI into recognizable character, corporation, and alliance names. Deleted or inaccessible entities retain explicit ID-based fallbacks instead of breaking analytics.

Killboard synchronization can refresh automatically when due, retains its cursor between visits, and preserves previously imported records when a source request fails.

zKillboard is used for discovery and enrichment. Its coverage should not be treated as a complete record of all combat activity.

Bounty Analytics

A new private, account-scoped Bounty Analytics module turns retained wallet-journal data into traceable ratting intelligence.

  • Detailed bounty payout ledger
  • Tick, hourly, and daily chart grouping
  • 1-day, 7-day, 30-day, 90-day, and all-history ranges
  • Pilot and historical-corporation filters
  • Total earned, average tick, largest tick, and active-pilot summaries
  • Pilot leaderboards with totals, tick counts, averages, and largest payouts
  • Drilldown from aggregate metrics to their contributing wallet entries
  • CSV export for external analysis

Bounty payouts are separated from ESS payments, mission rewards, market activity, and unrelated wallet income.

Corporate Tax Analytics

Where authoritative journal evidence permits it, EQM also reports:

  • Gross bounty
  • Corporation tax paid
  • Effective tax rate
  • Net bounty received
  • Tax totals by pilot and reporting period
  • Tax contribution drilldowns
  • Gross, tax, and net reconciliation coverage

Historical tax calculations preserve the corporation recorded when the entry was first imported. EQM does not retroactively apply a corporation’s current tax rate, and values remain Unknown when they cannot be safely established from ESI data.

Search All the Things

Large datasets should no longer require scrolling until morale improves.

Character Skills Finder

Find pilots by trained skills using:

  • Single or comma-separated skill names
  • All skills or Any skill matching
  • Minimum trained-level filtering
  • Matching pilot counts
  • Concise matched-skill badges

Examples:

  • Find everyone with Logistics Cruisers IV
  • Find pilots with both Jump Drive Calibration V and Jump Fuel Conservation IV
  • Find anyone with at least one requested capital-production skill

Additional Record Finders

Consistent search controls are now available for:

  • Research projects
  • Manufacturing jobs
  • Contracts
  • HyperNet offers
  • Jump clones
  • Clone implants
  • Custom implant sets

Existing Standings and Corporate Exchange searches remain available.

All searches respect the same visibility and authorization rules as their underlying modules.

One-Stop Character Synchronization

Sync all eligible on the Characters page now queues every authorized character dataset EQM collects:

  • Assets
  • Skills and skill queue
  • Fittings
  • Wallet history and transactions
  • Contracts
  • Industry jobs
  • Mining history
  • Planetary colonies
  • NPC standings
  • Jump clones
  • Active implants
  • Eligible corporation industry projects

If a character has multiple active ESI authorizations, EQM selects the newest token that is actually eligible for each dataset. One partial-scope authorization can no longer hide another usable token.

Progress displays the current character and readable dataset name on both the Characters page and the ESI Sync & Freshness Center.

Character-wide synchronization opt-outs remain hard exclusions. Wallet-history opt-outs skip wallet collection while allowing the character’s other authorized datasets to synchronize.

Better Analytics Scope

Analytics can now be scoped to:

  • All visible pilots
  • My data
  • A specific accessible corporation

The selected scope applies to eligible pilot history, skills, mining, research, planetary production, blueprints, standings, and corporation widgets without weakening Financial Analytics privacy protections.

Standings Movement

Four new baseline-aware widgets show the selected period’s:

  • Top 10 NPC corporation standing gains
  • Top 10 NPC corporation standing losses
  • Top 10 faction standing gains
  • Top 10 faction standing losses

Rankings use precise unmodified ESI base standings and exclude a pilot’s first observation so newly synchronized characters are not mistaken for enormous standing gains.

Exact Match Contact Sync

Character Contact Sync now includes an optional Exact Match mode.

After preview and confirmation, EQM can:

  • Create missing contacts
  • Update changed standings
  • Update watch-list states
  • Identify destination-only contacts
  • Remove contacts that do not exist on the selected source character

Operations are divided into ESI-safe batches and run as durable background jobs. Long multi-character copies return immediately, report per-target progress, survive page navigation, preserve completed targets when another fails, and recover queued or running work after a backend restart.

Reliability and Interface Improvements

  • Fixed wallet-journal synchronization exceeding PostgreSQL’s 65,535-parameter statement limit by using bounded, transaction-safe batches.
  • Removed enormous generated SQL dumps from Character Sync failure placards.
  • Fixed Jump Clone synchronization for clones located in Upwell structures by storing EVE location IDs as 64-bit integers.
  • Failed Jump Clone refreshes now explicitly confirm that previously synchronized data was preserved.
  • Character hover cards now render above tables and overflow panes.
  • Hover cards automatically reposition near viewport edges and follow scrolling or resizing.
  • Killboard entity names are retained in a dedicated refreshable cache.
  • Replaced the personalized Killboard heading with the installation-neutral EQM Violence Ledger.

Operator Notes

This release includes database migrations through 0074.

Apply the migrations and rebuild or restart the backend and frontend during the upgrade.

Killboard enablement, refresh period, historical lookback, request delay, and page ceiling can be configured by administrators without modifying source code.

As always, this remains beta software. Back up your database before upgrading, and please report anything suspicious—especially if the analytics imply your corporation has suddenly become organized.

EQM v0.1.22-beta — “After Action, Before the Jump”

EVE Quartermaster’s latest update brings better combat reporting, broader command-level analytics, safer capital navigation, and live traffic intelligence.

This release includes everything added since v0.1.21.1-beta.

Battle Reports

  • Reconstruct engagements dynamically from EQM’s existing Killboard data.
  • Review involved pilots, teams, organizations, timelines, damage, ship composition, losses, efficiency, and direct zKill evidence.
  • Browse older and newer engagements using stable historical records.
  • Correct unusual engagements with Edit Teams, including alliance-, corporation-, and pilot-level reclassification.
  • Share immutable public snapshots through revocable, unguessable links.
  • Public reports preserve the exact engagement and team assignments that were shared.
  • Added pilot portraits, corporation/alliance branding, ship imagery, and canonical SDE ship classes.
  • Improved friendly-fire and missing-affiliation handling so allies are not incorrectly classified as third parties.

Navigation and Traffic Intelligence

  • Added last-hour ESI activity to the Route Checker, Gatecheck, Jump Capable Ship Plotter, alternate jump candidates, and PvP Intel reports.
  • Every supported system can now display:
    • Ship jumps during the last hour
    • Ship kills during the last hour
    • Pod kills during the last hour
  • Traffic observations use ESI with a shared five-minute cache—no Dotlan scraping.
  • Supercarrier and titan routes now show only known Keepstar-class docking destinations.
  • NPC stations are excluded as supercapital docking targets.
  • Keepstar recommendations clearly warn that structural eligibility does not guarantee docking or tether access.
  • Refreshed character and corporation structure data can contribute accessible allied or public Keepstars.

Better Analytics for Leadership

  • Added role-aware scopes for:
    • My Pilots
    • All Pilots
    • Corporation
    • Alliance
  • Hosts and administrators can review bounty performance across all visible pilots instead of being limited to their own characters.
  • Directors remain constrained by their permitted affiliations.
  • Added convenient category navigation throughout Analytics.
  • Ordinary privacy opt-outs may contribute only to anonymous cohorts of at least three pilots.
  • Identifying drilldowns remain unavailable for those cohorts, helping prevent subtraction attacks.
  • HARD STOP data remains excluded from analytics for every role.

Sync and Deployment Improvements

  • Sync all eligible now queues every authorized character dataset registered with the Sync & Freshness Center, including Jump Clones and active implants.
  • EQM selects the newest usable authorization for each dataset when a character has multiple ESI tokens.
  • Bulk synchronization now reports the current dataset by its user-facing name.
  • Character and wallet privacy exclusions remain hard boundaries.
  • Hardened Docker build inputs to prevent local caches and development artifacts from contaminating production builds.
  • Added a significantly smaller WebP application logo for faster initial page loading.
  • Included the required database migrations for Battle Report shares, structure-type retention, and hourly system activity.

This remains beta software, so backups before updating are strongly encouraged.

EQM v0.1.23-beta — “Things Are Getting Rusty!”

Release: v0.1.23-beta

This release moves EQM’s heavy deterministic calculations into a shared Rust core while keeping permissions, database access, ESI enrichment, and privacy enforcement in Python. Every migrated module includes independent rollback controls, Python fallback, and shadow-parity testing.

Highlights

  • Rust-powered Analytics, Bounty Analytics, Financial Analytics, Planetary production history, Events, fleet composition, Killboard, SRP, Battle Reports, HyperNet economics, mining settlements, threat intelligence, jump routing, fitting calculations, and PI shortage reporting.
  • Dynamic Battle Reports with engagement reconstruction, team editing, historical browsing, composition analysis, pilot imagery, and revocable public snapshot links.
  • Improved Jump Capable Ship Plotter with live ESI traffic intelligence, reachable alternates, required cyno waypoints, POS routing, and supercapital-aware Keepstar docking targets.
  • Expanded HyperNet tracking for seller offers, seeded-node risk, buyer bids, outcome reconciliation, and combined lifetime performance.
  • Event analytics now reports attendance, registration gaps, doctrine requirements, hulls, roles, and unregistered RSVPs.
  • Planetary Industry reporting identifies shortages, upstream materials, source planets, projected production, and supply-chain bottlenecks.
  • Financial Analytics now handles daily wallet closes, growth, spending velocity, corporation carry-forward series, privacy-safe trend views, and wealth distributions.
  • Numerous synchronization, privacy, navigation, fitting, and analytics reliability improvements.

Release Validation

  • 11 Rust unit tests and 30 Rust contract tests
  • 350 backend tests and 9 subtests
  • TypeScript/Vite production build
  • Migration, Compose, runtime startup, and API-version checks

Things are getting rusty—and EQM is getting faster, more deterministic, and easier to validate.

##EQM - v0.1.23.1-beta — “Ooops, Let’s Patch That!” Hotfix

A production deployment issue exposed EQM’s Vite development server to the public internet. Automated scanners found it before they found anything useful, and this hotfix closes that door.

Hotfix: Hotfix Release v0.1.23.1-beta

Security fixes

  • Replaced the Vite development server with a compiled frontend served by Nginx.
  • Restricted frontend, backend, PostgreSQL, and Redis ports to the host.
  • Blocked Vite-specific and hidden-file probes.
  • Added security headers and rotating access logs.
  • Updated vulnerable Nano ID and PostCSS dependencies.
  • Marked Linux maintenance scripts executable.

No evidence of credential or sensitive-file disclosure was found. Updating is strongly recommended for remotely hosted EQM installations.
